tasks.label: deploy
args: set -euo pipefail; if [ ! -d /Volumes/CIRCUITPY ] || [ ! -f /Volumes/CIRCUITPY/boot_out.txt ]; then printf '%s\n' 'CIRCUITPY is not mounted. Connect the board in CircuitPython mode.' >&2; exit 1; fi; if [ ! -f settings.toml ]; then printf '%s\n' 'Local settings.toml is missing. Create it before deploying.' >&2; exit 1; fi; cp settings.toml /Volumes/CIRCUITPY/settings.toml; rsync -av --exclude='._*' --exclude='__pycache__/' --include='*/' --include='*.py' --exclude='*' reporters/ /Volumes/CIRCUITPY/reporters/; cp code.py /Volumes/CIRCUITPY/code.py; cp thresholds.py /Volumes/CIRCUITPY/thresholds.py; sync

tasks.label: add_deps
args: set -euo pipefail; if [ ! -d /Volumes/CIRCUITPY ] || [ ! -f /Volumes/CIRCUITPY/boot_out.txt ]; then printf '%s\n' 'CIRCUITPY is not mounted. Connect the board in CircuitPython mode.' >&2; exit 1; fi; for source in ./code.py ./reporters/*.py; do circup --path /Volumes/CIRCUITPY install --auto --auto-file "$source"; done; circup --path /Volumes/CIRCUITPY freeze -r
